data.strategy_desc:
🚀 INTERSTELLAR Pro | Multi-Pair AI Agent
INTERSTELLAR Pro is an automated quantitative strategy delivering consistent compound growth across 4 major pairs (EURUSD, GBPUSD, USDJPY, GBPJPY).

It combines M5/M15 technical analysis with real-time Python VPS supervision for top-tier capital protection and dynamic lot sizing.

🛡️ Key Advantages & Risk Control
Python Supervisor IPC: Real-time monitoring of Equity, margin, and lot scaling.
30% Safety Margin Cap: Automatic emergency pause against market spikes.
Organic Compounding: Dynamic lot scaling (+0.001 lots per $85 net profit).
ATR Spacing & Trailing: Volatility-adaptive grid with Post-TP Profit Floor.
MTF Trend Filter: M5 entries validated by M15 EMA 50 to avoid counter-trends.

📊 Recommended Copy Parameters
Minimum Capital: $2,000 (or equivalent on Cent/ECN).
Copy Mode: In proportion to Trader's Funds.
Profile: Balanced / Controlled Drawdown.

Follow our rule: invest only what you are willing to lose.
